import urllib.request,json,hashlib,datetime
base='https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/updates/'
out={}
for manifest,version in [('latest.json',8),('native/latest.json',13)]:
 req=urllib.request.Request(base+manifest,headers={'Cache-Control':'no-cache','User-Agent':'OnTrack-Voice-022-Verify'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=9) as r:body=r.read(32768);status=r.status
 meta=json.loads(json.loads(body)['payload'])
 out[manifest]={'http':status,'revision':meta.get('revision'),'version':meta.get('version_code')}
 assert status==200 and (meta.get('revision')==version or meta.get('version_code')==version)
 filename=('' if manifest=='latest.json' else 'native/')+meta['file']
 with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+filename,method='HEAD'),timeout=9) as r:code=r.status;size=int(r.headers.get('Content-Length','0'))
 assert code==200 and size==meta['size']
 out[manifest]['asset_http']=code;out[manifest]['asset_size']=size;out[manifest]['asset_matches']=True
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','resources':out,'checked_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}))
